title: The Effort Illusion: Why Your AI Users Feel More Productive Than They Are
blurb: Enterprises still measure AI impact by input — prompts written, tokens consumed, hours 'saved'. The research says users systematically overestimate their own gains, anchored on the effort they put in. What to measure instead.

title: Slaying Dragons with AI
blurb: Build your own local AI agent system in the room, then use it on something that matters to you. Bring a laptop and an AI tool that can reach local files.

title: Slaying Dragons with AI — WAVE Fellowship
blurb: A 90-minute hands-on session for the fellowship cohort: build a working local AI agent system, then point it at a future-self goal-setting exercise. Co-presented with Franziska-J. Klebôn.

title: Slaying Dragons with AI — Berlin Immersion
venue: Tomorrow University of Applied Sciences, Berlin
blurb: 60 minutes, 40 attendees, four working prototypes by the end of the hour. The write-up is the honest version, including what stopped the other thirty-six.
